messages.subject: Project Quartz — legal DD enquiries (first list)
messages.plaintextBody:
James, Elena,

Our first list of legal due diligence enquiries is attached to the data room Q&A log (folders 1-10). Priorities: the IP chain of title (all contractor/employee assignments), the equipment-finance security, the Innovate UK grant claw-back on change of control, and the FSA novel-foods position.

Grateful for replies by 6 March.

David

messages.plaintextBody:
David,

Replies uploaded to the Q&A log. Headlines: one former contractor's IP assignment is outstanding (chasing; draft deed in folder 6.3); Innovate UK has confirmed in writing that the round does not trigger claw-back (folder 8.4); the FSA pre-application meeting took place on 4 March and the dossier is in preparation. The supplier statutory demand is disputed and at folder 7.2.

These will be picked up in the disclosure letter.

Elena

Elena Marchetti
Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
